caveats: Public-source diagnostics and manufacturer product photos do not establish physical-phone camera accuracy.
Related artwork, capture sessions and public pretraining contamination may survive source/perceptual grouping.
Anime has very few explicitly audited groups; report its sample counts without claiming general anime accuracy.
The head classifies species/forms, not shiny-versus-normal appearance; no shiny-recognition claim is supported.
Reused public, alternate-form and natural-negative holdouts are diagnostics, separate from fresh source-group holdouts.

settings.acceptance_rule: predicted entry is eligible AND softmax(logits / temperature).max >= confidence AND raw top1-top2 logits >= margin
settings.tie_break: first column in supplied label order
settings.label_order_assumption: Producer must emit logits in supplied label order; optional per-row label_ids are checked.
settings.metric_definitions: Closed-set and calibration metrics use known targets only; macro scores average supported true classes. Precision uses known-target predictions. Brier is summed over all supplied classes. ECE uses equal-width confidence bins. Accepted accuracy includes accepted unknown images as errors; unknown_far uses unknown images only.

baseline.baseline_contamination_caveat: Public baseline contamination is known or unknown; public-source results are not independent promotion evidence. Automated duplicate grouping may miss related artwork or capture sessions. Independent camera evaluation is required before promotion.

bootstrap.caveat: Intervals condition on observed groups and support. Undefined paired draws are omitted and counted; one group cannot estimate population uncertainty.

comparison.direction: Higher is better except nll, brier, ece, and unknown_far. Coverage alone is not quality.
